title: FracGen: Learning How Objects Stretch and Tear with Physics-Informed Video Generation
title_zh: FracGen: 学习如何对象进行拉伸和撕裂的基于物理信息的视频生成模型

paragraphs.en: We introduce FracGen , a fracture-aware video generation model that produces plausible, controllable fracture dynamics from a single image of an intact object, conditioned on physics signals. To train FracGen, we build FracSim , a fracture-aware simulation framework that augments material point method (MPM) simulation with a continuum damage model, producing paired fracture videos and dense, pixel-aligned physical fields at no additional cost beyond standard rendering. FracGen leverages these maps in two ways: it is trained to jointly predict them alongside RGB video, encouraging the model to capture physical state rather than surface appearance; and it is supervised with physics-informed losses that encourage consistency among the predicted maps. As a result, FracGen captures distinct material-specific fracture behavior without expensive test-time simulation or per-scene tuning, while offering fine-grained control over where an object tears, how fast the crack propagates, and how much deformation precedes failure. We further introduce a benchmark for evaluating the physical plausibility of generated fracture video, and show through extensive experiments that FracGen outperforms existing video generation baselines in both physical and visual fidelity. Results are best viewed in our project website: https://fracgen.github.io/ .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 FracGen，一个具备断裂感知能力的视频生成模型，能够以物理信号为条件，从单张完好物体的图像生成合理且可控的断裂动态。 为了训练 FracGen，我们构建了 FracSim，一个断裂感知的仿真框架，它在物质点法（MPM）仿真基础上引入连续介质损伤模型，在无需超出标准渲染的额外成本的情况下，生成成对的断裂视频以及稠密且与像素对齐的物理场。 FracGen 以两种方式利用这些图：一是训练模型在生成 RGB 视频的同时联合预测这些图，促使模型捕捉物理状态而非表面外观；二是使用基于物理信息的损失函数进行监督，鼓励各预测图之间保持一致性。 因此，FracGen 无需昂贵的测试时仿真或针对场景的调优，即可捕捉不同材料特有的断裂行为，同时提供细粒度的控制，包括物体在哪里撕裂、裂纹扩展有多快，以及失效前发生多大程度的形变。 我们进一步引入了一个用于评估生成断裂视频物理合理性的基准，并通过大量实验表明，FracGen 在物理保真度和视觉保真度上均优于现有的视频生成基线。 结果最佳查看方式请访问我们的项目网站：https://fracgen.github.io/ 。

paragraphs.en: Things break all the time. We drop, tear or snap objects and know what a fracture or damage looks like. Bread breaking like glass or a mug tearing apart like paper looks immediately wrong. Any convincing fracture-generation algorithm must match these physical intuitions — not just the final broken shape, but also how an object deforms, when it starts to fail and how the fracture develops.
paragraphs.zh: 东西随时都在破碎。 我们会掉落、撕裂或折断物体，并且知道裂痕或损坏是什么样子的。 面包像玻璃一样碎裂，或者马克杯像纸一样被撕开，看起来会立刻显得不对劲。 任何令人信服的断裂生成算法都必须符合这些物理直觉——不仅要匹配最终破碎后的形状，还要匹配物体如何形变、何时开始失效以及断裂如何发展。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work shows that modern generative models internalize substantial knowledge of physical dynamics directly from data ( Bhattad et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Xing et al., 2025 ; Gillman et al., 2025 ) . In this paper, we ask whether this extends to fracture: can a video generator learn how objects break from limited data and lightweight fine-tuning?
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究表明，现代生成式模型能够直接从数据中内化大量关于物理动力学的知识（Bhattad et al., 2023；Du et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2024b；Wang et al., 2025；Xing et al., 2025；Gillman et al., 2025）。 在本文中，我们探讨这是否可以扩展到断裂：一个视频生成器能否通过有限的数据和轻量级的微调学习物体如何断裂？

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to condition video generation on physical signals. ForcePrompting ( Gillman et al., 2025 ) shows that generators can respond to push/pull forces, but does not explicitly model damage accumulation or fracture. Physics-based approaches address different parts of this problem. PhysGaussian ( Xie et al., 2024 ) produces physically grounded deformation but lacks a damage model for fracture, while Fracture-GS ( Wang et al., 2026 ) introduces a Collision Material Point Method (Collision-MPM) to simulate fracture under extreme mechanical collisions. These simulation pipelines require a reconstructed scene and configured physical conditions. Our goal is to instead start from a single photograph and specified material and force conditions, and answer by generating “what happens if I pull here until it breaks?”
paragraphs.zh: 近期工作已开始以物理信号为条件来生成视频。 ForcePrompting（Gillman et al., 2025）表明生成器可以响应推/拉力，但并未显式建模损伤累积或断裂。 基于物理的方法解决了该问题的不同部分。 PhysGaussian（Xie et al., 2024）能产生具有物理依据的形变，但缺乏用于断裂的损伤模型，而 Fracture-GS（Wang et al., 2026）则引入了碰撞物质点法（Collision-MPM）来模拟极端机械碰撞下的断裂。 这些仿真流水线需要一个重建的场景以及配置好的物理条件。 我们的目标是改为从单张照片以及指定的材料与受力条件出发，通过生成来回答“如果我在这里拉，直到它断裂，会发生什么？”

paragraphs.en: To this end, we introduce FracGen , a video generation model that produces fracture dynamics for objects under tensile stretch. We focus on stretch-to-tear fracture, where substantial deformation precedes failure, making the evolution before fracture an important part of the generation task. FracGen captures distinct material-specific behaviors, from objects that fail after little stretching to those that undergo large deformation before tearing apart.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出 FracGen，一个能为受拉伸作用的物体生成断裂动态的视频生成模型。 我们关注拉伸致裂断裂，即物体在失效前经历显著变形，这使得断裂前的演化成为生成任务的重要组成部分。 FracGen 能捕捉不同材料特有的行为，从 barely 拉伸即失效的物体，到在撕裂前经历大变形的物体。

sents.en: To this end, we introduce FracGen , a video generation model that produces fracture dynamics for objects under tensile stretch.
sents.zh: 为此，我们提出 FracGen，一个能为受拉伸作用的物体生成断裂动态的视频生成模型。

sents.en: FracGen captures distinct material-specific behaviors, from objects that fail after little stretching to those that undergo large deformation before tearing apart.
sents.zh: FracGen 能捕捉不同材料特有的行为，从 barely 拉伸即失效的物体，到在撕裂前经历大变形的物体。

paragraphs.en: Teaching a generator these behaviors requires supervision beyond visual appearance: RGB frames alone do not explicitly describe the mechanical state that leads to fracture. We observe that simulators like PhysGaussian already track rich physical information that is not exposed in their rendered videos. Each particle carries a deformation gradient, a 3 × 3 3\times 3 matrix encoding local deformation, from which strain can be computed and stress obtained through the material’s constitutive law. Particle velocities further describe the local motion. We introduce a damage field that tracks the accumulated failure state of each particle and governs fracture. Rendering these quantities as pixel-aligned maps alongside RGB frames yields dense, physically grounded supervision without additional simulation runs. We call this augmented simulation framework FracSim , and its rendered physical fields FracPhys Maps .
paragraphs.zh: 让生成器学会这些行为，需要超越视觉外观的监督：仅凭 RGB 帧无法显式描述导致断裂的力学状态。 我们观察到，像 PhysGaussian 这样的模拟器已经在追踪丰富的物理信息，只是这些信息并未在其渲染的视频中呈现出来。 每个粒子都携带一个变形梯度，即编码局部变形的 3 × 3 3\times 3 矩阵，由此可以计算应变，并通过材料的本构定律获得应力。 粒子速度进一步描述了局部运动。 我们引入一个损伤场，用于追踪每个粒子累积的失效状态并控制断裂。 将这些量与 RGB 帧一起渲染为像素对齐的图，即可在不额外增加模拟运行的情况下获得稠密且具有物理依据的监督信号。 我们将这一增强的模拟框架称为 FracSim ，并将其渲染出的物理场称为 FracPhys Maps 。

paragraphs.en: We use these maps in two complementary ways, forming our main technical contributions. First, we extend the video generator to jointly predict FracPhys Maps alongside the fracture RGB video, forcing the model to encode the underlying mechanical state rather than surface appearance alone. These maps also enable us to inspect the physical state underlying the generated video. Second, we introduce physics-informed losses, derived from constitutive modeling, that encourage consistency among the predicted physical channels: the predicted strain, stress, and damage representations are coupled through a latent consistency loss inspired by constitutive modeling and stress degradation. We further introduce a benchmark targeting the evaluation of physical alignment in generated fracture videos, along with extensive experiments comparing FracGen against baseline methods to quantify its effectiveness. In summary, our contributions include:
paragraphs.zh: 我们以两种互补的方式使用这些图，这构成了我们的主要技术贡献。 首先，我们扩展了视频生成器，使其在生成断裂RGB视频的同时联合预测FracPhys图，从而迫使模型编码潜在的力学状态，而不仅仅是表面外观。 这些图还使我们能够检查生成视频背后的物理状态。 其次，我们引入了源自本构建模的物理信息损失，以促进各预测物理通道之间的一致性：预测的应变、应力和损伤表示通过受本构建模和应力退化启发的潜在一致性损失相互耦合。 我们进一步引入了一个针对生成断裂视频物理对齐评估的基准，并通过将FracGen与基线方法进行广泛对比实验来量化其有效性。 总之，我们的贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: A recent line of work grounds 3D dynamics in continuum mechanics. PhysGaussian ( Xie et al., 2024 ) couples the Material Point Method (MPM) ( Hu et al., 2018 ) with 3D Gaussians, treating each Gaussian as both a rendering primitive and physical particle, while Gaussian Splashing ( Feng et al., 2025 ) adopts Position-Based Dynamics ( Macklin et al., 2016 ) for cohesive solid-fluid simulation. However, these solvers require manual scene specification and tedious parameter tuning. To tackle this, PhysDreamer ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) optimizes MPM material parameters against generative reference videos using differentiable simulation, whereas DreamPhysics ( Huang et al., 2025 ) optimizes directly via Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) ( Poole et al., 2023 ) . Physics3D ( Liu et al., 2024a ) and OmniPhysGS ( Lin et al., 2025 ) further expand SDS-driven optimization to richer constitutive models, incorporating viscoelastic damping or multi-material mixtures (elastic, plastic, fluid) within a single scene.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的一系列工作将三维动力学建立在连续介质力学的基础上。 PhysGaussian（Xie et al., 2024）将物质点法（MPM）（Hu et al., 2018）与三维高斯相结合，把每个高斯既视为渲染基元又视为物理粒子，而 Gaussian Splashing（Feng et al., 2025）则采用基于位置的动力学（Macklin et al., 2016）来实现内聚的固-流耦合模拟。 然而，这些求解器需要手动指定场景并进行繁琐的参数调整。 为解决这一问题，PhysDreamer（Zhang et al., 2024）利用可微仿真，针对生成的参考视频优化 MPM 材料参数，而 DreamPhysics（Huang et al., 2025）则通过分数蒸馏采样（SDS）（Poole et al., 2023）直接进行优化。 Physics3D（Liu et al., 2024a）和 OmniPhysGS（Lin et al., 2025）进一步将 SDS 驱动的优化扩展到更丰富的本构模型，在单一场景中引入了粘弹性阻尼或多材料混合物（弹性、塑性、流体）。

sents.en: A recent line of work grounds 3D dynamics in continuum mechanics.
sents.zh: 最近的一系列工作将三维动力学建立在连续介质力学的基础上。

sents.en: PhysGaussian ( Xie et al., 2024 ) couples the Material Point Method (MPM) ( Hu et al., 2018 ) with 3D Gaussians, treating each Gaussian as both a rendering primitive and physical particle, while Gaussian Splashing ( Feng et al., 2025 ) adopts Position-Based Dynamics ( Macklin et al., 2016 ) for cohesive solid-fluid simulation.
sents.zh: PhysGaussian（Xie et al., 2024）将物质点法（MPM）（Hu et al., 2018）与三维高斯相结合，把每个高斯既视为渲染基元又视为物理粒子，而 Gaussian Splashing（Feng et al., 2025）则采用基于位置的动力学（Macklin et al., 2016）来实现内聚的固-流耦合模拟。

sents.en: However, these solvers require manual scene specification and tedious parameter tuning.
sents.zh: 然而，这些求解器需要手动指定场景并进行繁琐的参数调整。

sents.en: To tackle this, PhysDreamer ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) optimizes MPM material parameters against generative reference videos using differentiable simulation, whereas DreamPhysics ( Huang et al., 2025 ) optimizes directly via Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) ( Poole et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 为解决这一问题，PhysDreamer（Zhang et al., 2024）利用可微仿真，针对生成的参考视频优化 MPM 材料参数，而 DreamPhysics（Huang et al., 2025）则通过分数蒸馏采样（SDS）（Poole et al., 2023）直接进行优化。

sents.en: Physics3D ( Liu et al., 2024a ) and OmniPhysGS ( Lin et al., 2025 ) further expand SDS-driven optimization to richer constitutive models, incorporating viscoelastic damping or multi-material mixtures (elastic, plastic, fluid) within a single scene.
sents.zh: Physics3D（Liu et al., 2024a）和 OmniPhysGS（Lin et al., 2025）进一步将 SDS 驱动的优化扩展到更丰富的本构模型，在单一场景中引入了粘弹性阻尼或多材料混合物（弹性、塑性、流体）。

paragraphs.en: With advances in video generation models, recent works seek to inject faithful physical realism through two main strategies. The first conditions generation on explicit control signals: Force Prompting ( Gillman et al., 2025 ) fine-tunes a video diffusion model on synthetic force-annotated data, PhysCtrl ( Wang et al., 2025 ) controls video diffusion using predicted 3D point-trajectories conditioned on forces and material traits, and PhyCo ( Narayanan et al., 2026 ) enables pixel-aligned ControlNet guidance over physical fields (friction, deformation, force) refined by VLM reward optimization. The second strategy enforces physics via high-level reasoning and reward alignment: DiffPhy ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) uses LLM context-builder alongside a MLLM physical critic, while PhyGDPO ( Cai et al., 2025 ) post-trains a video models using physics-aware groupwise preference optimization. However, these methods focus on rigid-body motion or simple deformation, lacking mechanisms for material failure. To the best of our knowledge, FracGen is the first model to generate complex fracture dynamics across the full deformation-to-fracture progression.
paragraphs.zh: 随着视频生成模型的进步，近期的工作尝试通过两种主要策略注入忠实的物理真实性。 第一种策略以显式控制信号为条件进行生成：Force Prompting（Gillman et al., 2025）在合成的力标注数据上微调视频扩散模型，PhysCtrl（Wang et al., 2025）使用以力和材料属性为条件预测的3D点轨迹来控制视频扩散，而PhyCo（Narayanan et al., 2026）通过VLM奖励优化精炼的物理场（摩擦、形变、力）实现像素级对齐的ControlNet引导。 第二种策略通过高层推理和奖励对齐来强制物理规律：DiffPhy（Zhang et al., 2025）使用LLM上下文构建器并结合MLLM物理评论器，而PhyGDPO（Cai et al., 2025）则使用物理感知的组内偏好优化对视频模型进行后训练。 然而，这些方法聚焦于刚体运动或简单形变，缺乏处理材料破坏的机制。 据我们所知，FracGen是首个能够生成从完整形变到断裂全过程的复杂断裂动力学的模型。

paragraphs.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) represents a scene using anisotropic Gaussian kernels that carry geometry and appearance. PhysGaussian ( Xie et al., 2024 ) couples this representation with the Material Point Method (MPM) ( Hu et al., 2018 ) , associating particles with evolving positions x p t x_{p}^{t} , velocities v p t v_{p}^{t} , and deformation gradients 𝑭 p t \bm{F}_{p}^{t} . MPM updates these states through transfers between particles and a background grid, while the Gaussians deform with the material to render its evolving appearance. The deformation map ϕ \phi transports a material point from its reference position x p x_{p} to x p t = ϕ ⁡ ( x p , t ) x_{p}^{t}=\phi(x_{p},t) . Its gradient, 𝑭 p t = ∇ x p ϕ ​ ( x p , t ) \bm{F}_{p}^{t}=\nabla_{x_{p}}\phi(x_{p},t) , encodes local stretching, compression, rotation, and shearing. The polar decomposition 𝑭 p = 𝑹 p ​ 𝑺 p \bm{F}_{p}=\bm{R}_{p}\bm{S}_{p} separates rigid rotation 𝑹 p \bm{R}_{p} from stretch 𝑺 p \bm{S}_{p} , allowing us to distinguish shape change from rigid motion.

paragraphs.en: Strain measures local deformation relative to the reference configuration, while stress describes the internal forces per unit area transmitted through the material. A constitutive model relates deformation to stress. For hyperelastic materials, a strain energy density ψ ⁡ ( 𝑭 ) \psi(\bm{F}) determines the stress response, which can be nonlinear while remaining reversible. In isotropic linear elasticity, Hooke’s law gives 𝝈 = λ L ​ tr ⁡ ( 𝜺 ) ​ 𝐈 + 2 ​ μ ​ 𝜺 \bm{\sigma}=\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}\operatorname{tr}(\bm{\varepsilon})\mathbf{I}+2\mu\bm{\varepsilon} , where λ L \lambda_{\mathrm{L}} and μ \mu are the Lamé parameters. FracSim computes stress from the material’s strain energy and introduces damage-dependent degradation, while our generator uses the linear-elastic relationship to motivate an approximate consistency loss in latent space.

paragraphs.en: FracGen is conditioned on three physics-guided signals: applied forces, material properties, and fracture properties. We detail their latent space encoding below:

sents.en: FracGen is conditioned on three physics-guided signals: applied forces, material properties, and fracture properties.
sents.zh: FracGen 以三种物理引导的信号为条件：施加的力、材料属性和断裂属性。

sents.en: We detail their latent space encoding below:
sents.zh: 我们在下面详细介绍它们的潜空间编码：

paragraphs.en: Applied Loading. We use opposing velocity signals mimicking a universal testing machine (UTM) and render it as moving Gaussian blobs across frames. Blob centers denote grip locations, fixed isotropic covariances define spatial extent, and displacements reflect velocity vectors. We use a frozen 3D VAE to encode this dynamic signal into latent y force ∈ ℝ ( 1 + T ′ ) × H ′ × W ′ × 16 y_{\text{force}}\in\mathbb{R}^{(1+T^{\prime})\times H^{\prime}\times W^{\prime}\times 16} , spatially and temporally aligned with the RGB video representation.
paragraphs.zh: 施加的载荷。 我们使用模拟万能试验机（UTM）的相反速度信号，并将其渲染为跨帧移动的高斯斑点。 斑点中心表示夹持位置，固定的各向同性协方差定义其空间范围，位移则反映速度向量。 我们使用冻结的 3D VAE 将该动态信号编码为潜在表示 y force ∈ ℝ ( 1 + T ′ ) × H ′ × W ′ × 16 y_{\text{force}}\in\mathbb{R}^{(1+T^{\prime})\times H^{\prime}\times W^{\prime}\times 16} ，其在空间和时间上与 RGB 视频表示对齐。

sents.en: Material Properties.
sents.zh: 材料属性。

sents.en: Material deformation and fracture depend heavily on Young’s modulus E E and Poisson’s ratio ν \nu .

sents.en: Instead of using an explicit encoder, we construct y mat ∈ ℝ ( 1 + T ′ ) × H ′ × W ′ × 2 y_{\text{mat}}\in\mathbb{R}^{(1+T^{\prime})\times H^{\prime}\times W^{\prime}\times 2} by broadcasting normalized parameter maps across space and time.

paragraphs.en: For simulation, we sample 10 objects from the Objaverse dataset ( Deitke et al., 2022 ) and SketchFab platform, covering two common material classes in stretch-to-tear fracture: 5 high-stretch objects (rubber toys) and 5 low-stretch objects (croissant, cake, muffin, bread, and bread roll). We then use FracSim to yield a paired dataset of RGB fracture videos and dynamic physics maps for generative training by varying different force condition, material properties, and fracture properties (more details can be seen in § A ). For training, we leverage this simulated data to train our FracGen model. Among 10 objects, simulated results for 6 objects (3 low-stretch and 3 high-stretch objects) with varying conditions are used for training, yielding 4,212 training samples in total. More details on simulation and training setting could be found in § A ).

paragraphs.en: Constitutive Consistency ( 𝐑 c ​ o ​ n ​ s 2 \mathbf{R}^{2}_{cons} ). Unlike other metrics that evaluates physics map individually, this one evaluate the consistency among physics map. paragraphs.en: We compare FracGen against recent physics-aware video generation models (e.g., ForcePrompting, PhyCo) and video generation baselines (e.g., CogVideoX). We do not compare against PhysCtrl ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , as it encodes force as a single force vector, which cannot represent our dual opposing forces. In contrast, ForcePrompting and PhyCo encode force as rendered, pixel-aligned control videos, so we extend them to our two-grip setup by rendering both grips in the control signal, and fine-tune them on the same data (more details in § A ). As shown in Tab. 1 and Fig. 4 . FracGen achieves superior performance across all metrics, excelling in both video quality and physical alignment (SAC). Qualitatively, baselines fail to capture realistic stretching, and fracture progressions, while FracGen faithfully captures this behavior. More results are on our project website.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 FracGen 与近期的物理感知视频生成模型（例如 ForcePrompting、PhyCo）以及视频生成基线（例如 CogVideoX）进行比较。 我们没有与 PhysCtrl（Wang et al., 2025）进行比较，因为它将力编码为单个力向量，无法表示我们的双向对拉力。 相比之下，ForcePrompting 和 PhyCo 将力编码为渲染的、像素对齐的控制视频，因此我们通过在控制信号中渲染两个夹持点来将它们扩展到我们的双夹持设置，并在相同数据上对其进行微调（更多细节见 § A）。 如 Tab. 1 和 Fig. 4 所示。 FracGen 在所有指标上都取得了更优的性能，在视频质量和物理对齐（SAC）方面均表现出色。 从定性结果来看，基线方法无法捕捉真实的拉伸和断裂扩展过程，而 FracGen 则忠实地捕捉了这一行为。 更多结果请见我们的项目网站。

paragraphs.en: With constitutive loss, Stage 3 yields the largest gains across all levels. paragraphs.en: We show that pretrained video generators can be adapted to learn material-dependent stretching and tearing from simulation-derived supervision. To our knowledge, FracGen is the first video generation framework to jointly predict material-dependent tearing and the associated physical fields from a single image and specified physical conditions. FracSim provides paired videos and physical maps for joint prediction, while physics-consistency losses encourage agreement among the predicted fields. These allow us to inspect how estimated strain, stress and damage evolve. As video models improve and the materials community releases more datasets, we envision a feedback loop: experimental data improves generative models, and fast predictions help prioritize new experiments. With experimental validation, this could accelerate material-response prediction and support materials discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们表明，预训练视频生成器可以通过源自仿真的监督进行适配，学习依赖材料的拉伸与撕裂行为。 据我们所知，FracGen 是首个从单张图像和给定物理条件出发、联合预测依赖材料的撕裂及相关物理场的视频生成框架。 FracSim 提供成对的视频和物理图用于联合预测，同时物理一致性损失促使各预测场之间保持一致。 这使我们能够观察估计出的应变、应力和损伤如何演化。 随着视频模型的改进以及材料学界发布更多数据集，我们预见到一个反馈循环：实验数据改进生成模型，而快速预测又有助于优先安排新的实验。 经过实验验证，这一方法有望加速材料响应预测并支持材料发现。

paragraphs.en: Our work focuses on deformation and tearing under tensile loading. Brittle fracture and fragmentation under impact are outside our training and evaluation scope. Extending FracGen to these material types would require appropriate simulation data and failure models. The model also inherits the assumptions of its training simulator, so any errors in FracSim would also reflect in FracGen. Finally, multi-step diffusion sampling limits inference speed. Few-step distillation could reduce this cost, provided it preserves fracture behavior and consistency among the predicted physical fields.

paragraphs.en: FracSim 4.1 produces a set of per-frame 2D physics maps: three scalar fields (stress, strain, damage) and one vector field (flow). Before VAE encoding, each raw map is normalized per video and linearly rescale (clipping) into [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . For the scalar fields (stress, strain, damage), the normalized scalar is replicated identically across the three RGB channels, yielding a grayscale RGB video in which pixel intensity encodes physical magnitude; background pixels normalize to exactly zero and render as black. For the flow field, which is a 2D vector rather than a scalar, we instead apply a Middlebury-style optical-flow color-wheel encoding ( Baker et al., 2007 ) . Zero flow therefore also renders as black, consistent with the convention used for the scalar fields (Note that this is what the model sees during training, for visualization as shown in Fig. 5 , we map it back to white background for the ease of visualization). Since the 3D VAE expects RGB input, each physics map is now a standard RGB video after this pre-processing, requiring no architectural change to accommodate a new modality. We feed each pre-processed physics-map video into the frozen 3D VAE to obtain its latent, as described in § 4.2 .
paragraphs.zh: FracSim 4.1 生成一组逐帧的 2D 物理图：三个标量场（应力、应变、损伤）和一个向量场（流动）。 在 VAE 编码之前，每个原始图都会按视频进行归一化，并线性重缩放（裁剪）到 [0,1] 区间。 对于标量场（应力、应变、损伤），归一化后的标量被完全相同地复制到三个 RGB 通道上，得到一个灰度 RGB 视频，其中像素强度编码物理量大小；背景像素归一化后恰好为零，呈现为黑色。 对于流动场，由于其是 2D 向量而非标量，我们改用 Middlebury 风格的光流色轮编码（Baker et al., 2007）。 因此零流动同样呈现为黑色，与标量场所采用的约定保持一致（注意这是模型在训练时所看到的输入；至于如图 5 所示的可视化，为了便于观察，我们将其映射回白色背景）。 由于 3D VAE 期望 RGB 输入，经过上述预处理后，每个物理图都成为标准的 RGB 视频，因此无需对架构做任何改动即可容纳这一新模态。 我们将每个预处理后的物理图视频输入冻结的 3D VAE 以获得其潜变量，具体描述见 §4.2。

paragraphs.en: Material Point Method (MPM) ( Jiang et al., 2016 ) is a hybrid Eulerian–Lagrangian discretization for continuum mechanics. MPM represent a body with a set of Lagrangian material points (particles), carrying position 𝐱 p \mathbf{x}_{p} , velocity 𝐯 p \mathbf{v}_{p} , mass m p m_{p} , and deformation gradient 𝐅 p \mathbf{F}_{p} . The deformation gradient 𝐅 p \mathbf{F}_{p} tracks the particle’s accumulated deformation, encoding rotation and strain which mainly drives the constitutive strain-stress response. At each MPM simulation step, mass and momentum are transferred to grid nodes (P2G); grid velocities are updated under internal stress and external constraints; the updated velocities are interpolated back to the particles for advection (G2P); and each particle’s deformation gradient is evolved accordingly

paragraphs.en: Our two material classes differ in their hyperelastic energy density (fixed corotated vs. neo-Hookean), elastic constants, and damage thresholds: FracSim couples hyperelasticity to continuum damage, with no yield surface and no return mapping ( F P = I F^{P}=I ). The cost is that we reproduce the visual distinction between materials that tear at low stretch and those that sustain large stretch, but not the permanent deformation of true ductile (plastic) fracture.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的两种材质类别在超弹性能量密度（固定旋转与 neo-Hookean）、弹性常数以及损伤阈值上有所不同：FracSim 将超弹性与连续介质损伤耦合，没有屈服面，也没有回映（ F P = I F^{P}=I ）。 这是有意为之，因为损伤阈值将断裂时机作为一个可直接控制的量暴露出来，而这正是 FracGen 所条件依赖的。 代价是，我们能够再现低拉伸下撕裂的材质与能承受大拉伸的材质之间的视觉差异，但无法再现真正韧性（塑性）断裂中的永久变形。

paragraphs.en: Following PhysGaussian ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , we optimize 3DGS per object using an anisotropy regularizer and internal particle filling. Fracture is produced by a continuum damage model coupled to MPM (§ 4.1 ), and diversity is obtained by sampling loading, constitutive model, material properties constants, and fracture properties. Every simulation is fully specified by a single configuration, which makes each sample reproducible. All runs use 100 100 frames with 100 100 MPM substeps per frame ( Δ ​ t = 10 − 4 \Delta t=10^{-4} s), a 150 3 150^{3} background grid over the normalized domain [ 0 , 2 ] 3 [0,2]^{3} , and no gravity, so that the observed deformation is attributable solely to the prescribed load. Across combinations of object, loading, and material/fracture parameters, FracSim yields a paired dataset of RGB fracture videos and dynamic physics maps for generative training.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 PhysGaussian（Xie et al., 2024），我们使用各向异性正则化器和内部粒子填充对每个物体优化 3DGS。 断裂由与 MPM 耦合的连续介质损伤模型产生（§ 4.1），多样性则通过采样载荷、本构模型、材料属性常数和断裂属性获得。 每次仿真都由单一配置完全指定，这使得每个样本都可复现。 所有运行均使用 100 100 帧，每帧 100 100 个 MPM 子步（Δ​t = 10^{−4} s），在归一化域 [0, 2]^{3} 上使用 150^{3} 的背景网格，并且不施加重力，以便观察到的形变可完全归因于所施加的载荷。 在物体、载荷以及材料/断裂参数的各种组合下，FracSim 生成了用于生成式训练的成对数据集，包含 RGB 断裂视频和动态物理图。

paragraphs.en: Uniaxial Opposing Forces: Tensile loading is applied kinematically. We select two thin slabs of MPM particles on opposite sides of the object center (thickness 0.05 0.05 in simulation units, i.e. roughly one grid cell, and wide enough to span the object’s cross-section) and prescribe their velocities to ± v ​ 𝐮 ^ \pm v\,\hat{\mathbf{u}} for the entire clip, where 𝐮 ^ \hat{\mathbf{u}} is the tearing axis. Because the velocity is enforced on particles rather than on grid nodes, the grips move rigidly with the material and the remaining particles respond through the constitutive law. We vary the speed v ∈ [ 0.2 , 1.5 ] v\in[0.2,1.5] , the tearing axis over 12 12 directions in the image plane ( 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} to 165 ∘ 165^{\circ} in 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} steps), the grip offset from the center ( 0.10 0.10 – 0.25 0.25 ), and the uniaxial tensile stretch mode.
paragraphs.zh: 单轴对向力：以运动学方式施加拉伸载荷。 我们在物体中心两侧各选取一层薄的 MPM 粒子薄板（在模拟单位中厚度为 0.05，即大约一个网格单元，且宽度足以覆盖物体的横截面），并在整个片段中将其速度规定为 ± v ​ 𝐮 ^ \pm v\,\hat{\mathbf{u}}，其中 𝐮 ^ \hat{\mathbf{u}} 是撕裂轴。 由于速度是施加在粒子上而非网格节点上，夹持端随材料一起刚性移动，其余粒子则通过本构律作出响应。 我们改变速度 v ∈ [ 0.2 , 1.5 ] v\in[0.2,1.5]、图像平面内 12 个方向上的撕裂轴（从 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} 到 165 ∘ 165^{\circ}，以 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} 为步长）、夹持端相对中心的偏移量（0.10 至 0.25）以及单轴拉伸模式。

paragraphs.en: Constitutive Model: We match the constitutive model to the deformation regime each material reaches before it fails. For low-stretch objects like bread, we use the fixed-corotated model, which is accurate and stable at small-to-moderate strain. For high-stretched object like rubber toys, it sustain stretches of 3 × 3\times or more before failing, which requires a genuinely finite-strain energy density; for these we use the compressible neo-Hookean model, a standard model of rubber elasticity.
paragraphs.zh: 本构模型：我们将本构模型与每种材料在失效前所达到的变形状态相匹配。 对于像面包这类低拉伸物体，我们使用固定旋转模型，该模型在小到中等应变下既准确又稳定。 对于像橡胶玩具这类高拉伸物体，其在失效前可承受3倍（3 × 3\times）或更大的拉伸，这需要真正的有限应变能量密度；对此我们使用可压缩新胡克模型，这是一种标准的橡胶弹性模型。

paragraphs.en: Fracture Properties: We augment each particle with a scalar damage d p ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] d_{p}\in[0,1] ( 0 0 intact, 1 1 broken) ( Lemaître, 1985 ) . After each substep we take the principal stretches of 𝐅 p \mathbf{F}_{p} (its singular values) and update damage from the largest one as discussed in Eq. 4 and degrade the particle’s stress contribution to the grid. The onset stretch λ onset \lambda_{\text{onset}} sets how far material can stretch before weakening; while the crit stretch indicates the critical stretch. Varying these thresholds independently of E E and ν \nu decouples when an object breaks from how it deforms beforehand, and is the main source of qualitative diversity in fracture patterns.

paragraphs.en: We leverage simulated data from FracSim to train our FracGen model. Among 10 objects, simulated results from 6 objects are used for training (3 low-stretch and 3 high-stretch) and 4 objects are used for testing, and benchmarking (2 low-stretch and 2 high-stretch). Our model is finetuned from a pre-trained Wan 2.1-Fun-V1.1-1.3B-Control ( Wan et al., 2025 ) using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) with rank 64, applied to the query, key, value, output, and feed-forward projections of the DiT backbone. We use the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 1e-4, weight decay of 0.01, and a cosine learning-rate schedule with a 40-step warmup. Each video clip consists of 81 frames, and the model is trained with a per-GPU batch size of 1 and gradient accumulation of 4 steps across 4 GPUs, yielding an effective batch size of 16. The total training samples are 4,212 training samples, and total testing/benchmarking samples are 2,808. Additionally, we also collect 10 random object images to further test generalization of FracGen across different new objects. We show images of these objects in Fig. 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用 FracSim 生成的仿真数据来训练 FracGen 模型。 在 10 个物体中，来自 6 个物体的仿真结果用于训练（3 个低拉伸和 3 个高拉伸），4 个物体用于测试和基准评估（2 个低拉伸和 2 个高拉伸）。 我们的模型从一个预训练的 Wan 2.1-Fun-V1.1-1.3B-Control（ Wan et al., 2025 ）出发，使用秩为 64 的 LoRA（ Hu et al., 2022 ）进行微调，LoRA 应用于 DiT 主干网络的查询、键、值、输出以及前馈投影。 我们使用 AdamW 优化器，学习率为 1e-4，权重衰减为 0.01，并采用带有 40 步预热的余弦学习率调度。 每个视频片段包含 81 帧，模型训练时每块 GPU 的批大小为 1，梯度累积为 4 步，分布在 4 块 GPU 上，从而得到 16 的有效批大小。 训练样本总数为 4,212 个，测试/基准评估样本总数为 2,808 个。 此外，我们还收集了 10 张随机物体图像，以进一步测试 FracGen 在不同新物体上的泛化能力。 我们在图 8 中展示了这些物体的图像。

paragraphs.en: ForcePrompting ( Gillman et al., 2025 ) fine-tunes a ControlNet on CogVideoX-5B-I2V to follow a rendered Gaussian-blob control video encoding a single applied force (a point poke or a global wind direction). Since tearing requires two opposing pulls rather than one, we extend its point-force conditioning with a custom double-force variant that renders and sums two independent Gaussian blobs at the two grip locations, matching the force representation FracGen consumes. We then finetune this ControlNet on our FracSim force-blob/RGB pairs under the matched protocol. The backbone remains frozen, following the original method. There are no conditions on other channels such as Young’s modulus, Poisson’s ratio, or fracture thresholds, so this baseline sees the same grips and the same pull velocities as FracGen but cannot be told what the object is made of.
paragraphs.zh: ForcePrompting（Gillman 等，2025）在 CogVideoX-5B-I2V 上微调一个 ControlNet，使其跟随一段渲染出的高斯斑点控制视频，该视频编码单次施加的力（点戳或全局风向）。 由于撕裂需要两个方向相反的拉力而非单个力，我们对其点力条件机制进行了扩展，设计了一个自定义的双力变体：在两个抓握位置分别渲染并叠加两个独立的高斯斑点，以匹配 FracGen 所使用的力表示。 随后，我们在匹配的协议下，用 FracSim 的力斑点/RGB 配对数据对该 ControlNet 进行微调。 骨干网络保持冻结，遵循原方法。 该方法没有对其他通道（如杨氏模量、泊松比或断裂阈值）施加条件，因此这一基线方法看到的抓握点和拉力速度与 FracGen 相同，但无法获知物体由什么材质构成。

paragraphs.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) represents a static 3D scene as a set of anisotropic Gaussian kernels { G p } p = 1 𝒫 \{G_{p}\}_{p=1}^{\mathcal{P}} . paragraphs.en: Dynamic fracture ( Kachanov, 1999 ; Lemaître, 1985 ; Wolper et al., 2019 ; Patnaik and Semperlotti, 2021 ) is among the most challenging phenomena to model in continuum mechanics. A central concept is material ductility —the capacity to deform plastically before failure—which separates the two canonical fracture modes. Ductile fracture occurs in materials that sustain large deformation under load, typically necking before the cross-section separates, whereas brittle fracture occurs at very low strains, often below 5 % 5\% , with little observable deformation prior to failure. In this work, we target the kinematic regime of ductile fracture (large deformation before failure), modeled via hyperelasticity with stretch-driven damage rather than plasticity. Specifically, we study fracture under uniaxial tensile loading, where two opposing forces act along a common axis, causing the object to stretch, deform, and eventually break. Under load, the body extends along the loading (longitudinal) direction while contracting in the transverse directions. Prior work on fracture simulation achieves high physical fidelity but requires expert knowledge to configure the governing parameters. CD-MPM ( Wolper et al., 2019 ) models dynamic ductile fracture through continuum damage mechanics, coupling a phase-field damage evolution with the MPM to capture large-deformation crack propagation. To reduce the heavy runtime and memory cost of full-order solvers, Neural Stress Fields (NSF) ( Zong et al., 2023 ) learns a low-dimensional manifold of the Kirchhoff stress field through an implicit neural representation, enabling reduced-order simulation of elastoplasticity and fracture. These methods, however, target physical simulation or geometric fragmentation, and expose control only through low-level physical parameters. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to bring stretch-to-tear fracture to a generative model—teaching a video generator the full deformation-to-fracture progression under comprehensive input conditioning, so that users can control which object to break, when it should break, how it breaks. FracSim captures the kinematic signature of this regime — large stretch, necking, progressive separation — through damage accumulation rather than plastic flow.
paragraphs.zh: 动态断裂（Kachanov, 1999; Lemaître, 1985; Wolper et al., 2019; Patnaik and Semperlotti, 2021）是连续介质力学中最难建模的现象之一。 一个核心概念是材料延性——即在失效前发生塑性变形的能力——它区分了两种经典的断裂模式。 延性断裂发生在受载下能承受大变形的材料中，典型表现是横截面分离前出现颈缩；而脆性断裂发生在极低的应变下，通常低于 5% 5\%，失效前几乎没有可观察到的变形。 在本工作中，我们针对延性断裂的运动学机制（失效前的大变形），通过具有拉伸驱动损伤的超弹性而非塑性来进行建模。 具体而言，我们研究单轴拉伸载荷下的断裂，此时两个相反的力沿同一轴线作用，使物体拉伸、变形并最终断裂。 在载荷作用下，物体沿加载（纵向）方向伸长，同时在横向方向收缩。 以往的断裂模拟工作具有很高的物理保真度，但需要专家知识来配置控制参数。 CD-MPM（Wolper et al., 2019）通过连续介质损伤力学来建模动态延性断裂，将相场损伤演化与 MPM 相耦合，以捕捉大变形下的裂纹扩展。 为降低全阶求解器高昂的运行时与内存开销，Neural Stress Fields（NSF）（Zong et al., 2023）通过隐式神经表示学习 Kirchhoff 应力场的低维流形，从而实现弹塑性与断裂的降阶模拟。 然而，这些方法面向物理模拟或几何破碎，且仅通过底层物理参数提供控制。 据我们所知，我们的工作首次将拉伸至撕裂断裂引入生成模型——通过全面的输入条件约束，教会视频生成器完整的从变形到断裂的过程，使用户能够控制破坏哪个物体、何时破坏以及如何破坏。 FracSim 通过损伤累积而非塑性流动来捕捉这一机制的运动学特征——大幅拉伸、颈缩、渐进分离。
